test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

Rohan said, “I will arrive late.”

options.text: Rohan says that he is late in his arrival.
Rohan said that he would arrive late.
Rohan said that I will arrive late.
Rohan said that he is arriving late.

solution:
The correct answer is **'****Rohan said that he would arrive late'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in** direct speech** and is in **quoted form **while** indirect **speech refers to** reporting the quoted form **into normal sentence.
 
• Here, while removing the quotations, **'said'** becomes** 'said that' **and **'I will arrive'** becomes **'he would arrive'**.
 
• So, when converting the given sentence in direct speech to indirect speech, **'Rohan said, “I will arrive late.”'** becomes **'Rohan said that he would arrive late'**.

Thus, the **correct answer** is: *Rohan said that he would arrive late.*

The correct answer is option 2.
